Crowns up, kings out 👑🖤

Azúcar presents Night of Kings — a full lineup of drag kings ready to melt the room down. Cherry Pop steps into the host chair for the very first time, bringing out eight kings who are about to run this stage: Phish Tako making their King debut, Puddlezz back in the scene as King Puddles, Jen Durless trading lace for leather-and-swagger, Beah Hazard and Dominic Trix debuting their king personas, Edward Demizer bringing Yakima heat, Sr Night Haven Rexia stepping from the DJ booth into the spotlight, and Dick Van Dykeotomy debuting in drag for the very first time ever.

That's not a lineup, that's a whole coronation. Screenshot it, send it to the group chat, grab your tickets before this room fills up.

📅 Sunday, July 26 — Doors 7PM / Show 8PM
📍 Azucar at Out & About — 327 W Lewis St, Pasco WA
💵 $15-$20
🔞 21+
#AzucarPasco #OutAndAbout #NightOfKings #DragKings #PascoWA #TriCities #DragNight #LatinxCommunity

The lights dim. The bass drops. The room belongs to the kings 🖤🔥

Smoke curling under red light, Cherry Pop's voice cutting through the crowd, and eight kings serving swagger and heartthrob energy one number at a time. Some of these faces you know, some are stepping into their king era for the very first time tonight — either way, the tips are flying and the floor doesn't stop until the last lip sync hits.

Feel the bass in your chest. Feel yourself losing your voice cheering for your favorite. This is a full sensory takeover, and Sunday nights were made for exactly this.

Mark it, set a reminder, tell your people — Night of Kings is coming 👑

Doors open at 7PM, show hits at 8PM, and Cherry Pop is running the whole night as host. Grab your crew, wear your best, and come scream for the kings.
